entry_points.text: Display entry prepares heap, captures params, saves screen, probes cards, resolves mode retrying until accepted, records result, captures identity, refreshes and conditionally restores.
Host tool emits capability name array guarded by mask except final slot; shared helpers normalize to page starts and walk requesting shared, with secure wrapper inert unless extension is reported.

exports.text: Fault entry shows registers with user-restricted view and kernel trace; classifiers map addresses to task, entry, IRQ, softIRQ, DF and exception stacks with bounds, links, tags, success/invalid codes and loop-stopping visited mask.

Frame, guess and table engines expose return-slot query and advance iterator; guess never finds a slot, frame uses register or successor slot, table uses register field or word below, expected frame failures end quietly.

Early services load static GDT, refresh segments and load IDT with optional virt entry, encrypt in place via paired views then reload, and expose two 32-bit plus one 64-bit EFI entries with firmware thunk.

hazards.text: Bad frames trigger one-time warning with task identity and full aligned dump collapsing zeros with symbols, then suppressed.

Prompting drains, waits bounded distinguishing continue and list with feedback, shows modes and accepts or rescans; indefinite retry with tick-dependent timeout can stall boot on dead clock or bad choices.

invariants.text: Die shows registers and modules then offers oops with current trap as fault signal with stop meaning handled; remote traces suspend sanitizer; trace derives SP, retries page-aligned, shows kernel text only with reliable versus hint marking and trampoline expansion; logger pets watchdog.

Register display requires containment, deferring otherwise; 32-bit IRQ/softIRQ accept exclusive top with base link and DF uses entry area with segment link; 64-bit exception rejects guards with trailing-reg link and IRQ uses adjusted exclusive top with reserved-cell link.

Last frame matches exact, realigned-duplicate or tracer patterns; updates allow only upward moves, follow links across empty stacks, decode register pointers, zero user returns and capture SP; low-bit versus top-bit encodings observed with entry-range quieting.
Lookup maps zero to null, block-indexed kernel search, slow init scan, rightmost-duplicate binary search tolerating terminators, then modules, JIT assumption and trampoline remap avoiding recursion.

Stepping ends on user mode, handles signal/call lookup with fallback marking unreliable, fails undefined and ends on end-of-stack; SP, caller and base come from selectors with fixes, rejecting non-advance; reads validate with refresh, 32-bit full rejected; regs need current view.

Screen save keeps text cells only when heap fits; restore skips graphics or missing data, adapts with fill and clamps cursor; raw mode prefers visible probed entries else hidden exceptional ranges; timing derives lines from font and rows and programs registers via status-selected indexed base.

Input drains, blocks, tests pending via flag absence and polls seconds with 30-count timeout; keyboard is 0x16, time is 0x1A seconds; menu edits four hex chars with backspace, empty means current, lists visible with adaptive columns.

Long-mode path enables extension, long-mode flag, disables interrupts for unsafe vectors, then paging; five-level state is inherited with shift and count; post-startup strips encryption after shared transitions; ranges split unaligned ends and aligned large middle preserving leaves.
Diagnostics use deferred once-only warnings with current-task suppression and single debug dump; moves align pointers to next range.

locks.text: Table stepping holds scoped read guard across lookup and derivation so module metadata cannot vanish mid-read.

state_machines.text: Mode activation treats current as no-op, maps legacy aliases, delegates to raw resolver, applies recalculation and persists canonical id except wakeup.

Firmware handover extends table with 64-bit entry, maps identity pages, enables long mode and far jumps remapped; thunk leaves paging to run target then restores disabled and far returns; level toggle drops to compat, updates tables paging-off, flips control and returns patched.

structs.text: Video keeps per-card safety, counts, tables and names, per-mode geometry and screen state with idempotent discovery; queries use 0x10 and DDC 0x4F15 gated on 2.0 with 0x004F status, identity prefills 0x13, text is 0xB000 for mono 0x07 else 0xB800.
Boot uses packed bound-plus-address descriptor record and page-aligned vector table; SMAP is 0x534D4150; format flags are powers of two from zero-pad 1 through alternate 64.
